provider: HKUST and Nazarbayev University BBA in Eurasian Business curriculum
note: The official joint-program curriculum publishes a 120-credit structure: 47 Business Core credits, 23 Business Major credits, 12 Business Elective credits, 27 University Common Core credits, 11 Free Elective credits and 0-credit Legal Education. This supplement records 33 unique explicit codes: all 16 Business Core rows, the ten individually named Major candidates from the curriculum and EABU course page, the six bounded Nazarbayev University business-elective candidates converted from 6 NU ECTS credits to 3 HKUST credits as the official table instructs, and LEGL 1000. The Major language rule is two Kazakh courses or one Kazakh plus one Russian; KAZ 150, KAZ 201, KAZ 202 and RFL 103 are the complete named language candidates published on the EABU course page. The requirement table names EABU 3040 and EABU 3050 with 'Eurasia', while their detailed course cards use 'Asia'; the requirement-table titles are retained and the conflict remains a manual source check. The open requirement for any three 2000-4000-level HKUST School of Business and Management courses, generic Common Core areas, free electives and uncoded communication choices are not expanded into fabricated closed lists. The published rows remain a read-only planning subset with totalCreditRequired=0 and must not produce a graduation-completion percentage.
